library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(readxl)
# Read CSV raw data (skip the 2-line header) for reference
raw <- read.csv("inputs/expression-matrix-444444444444.csv", skip = 2, check.names = FALSE)

diff_df <- read_excel("inputs/differential-results-333333333333.xlsx")

# Build a clean differential-analysis data frame
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(readxl)
# Read the precomputed differential analysis
diff_df <- read_excel("inputs/differential-results-333333333333.xlsx")
# Drop rows missing id or with NA stats, and remove zero p-values
df <- as.data.frame(diff_df)
df <- df[!is.na(df$id) & !is.na(df$log2FoldChange) & !is.na(df$pvalue), ]
df <- df[df$pvalue > 0, ]
cat("Clean rows:", nrow(df), "\n")
# Compute -log10(p) and significance
df$neg_log10_p <- -log10(df$pvalue)
FC_THRESH <- 1        # |log2FC| cutoff
P_THRESH  <- 0.05     # p-value cutoff (use adjusted would be safer; sticking to file)
df$status <- "NS"
df$status[df$log2FoldChange >  FC_THRESH & df$pvalue < P_THRESH] <- "Up"
df$status[df$log2FoldChange < -FC_THRESH & df$pvalue < P_THRESH] <- "Down"
cat("Status counts:\n")
print(table(df$status))
# Top genes for labeling (top by significance in each direction)
top_up   <- head(df[df$status == "Up",   ][order(df[df$status == "Up",   ]$pvalue), ], 12)
top_down <- head(df[df$status == "Down", ][order(df[df$status == "Down", ]$pvalue), ], 12)
label_ids <- unique(c(top_up$id, top_down$id))
df$label <- ifelse(df$id %in% label_ids, df$id, "")
cat("Labels to draw:", length(label_ids), "\n")
# Save for the next cell
saveRDS(df, "diff_df_clean.rds")

library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
df <- readRDS("diff_df_clean.rds")
# Reorder status for plotting
df$status <- factor(df$status, levels = c("Down", "NS", "Up"))
# Common volcano-plot limits
xlim_range <- max(abs(df$log2FoldChange)) * 1.05
ylim_range <- max(df$neg_log10_p) * 1.05
# "Diagonal volcano plot":
#   - log2FC on x-axis, -log10(p) on y-axis
#   - The two diagonal dashed lines are the joint (|log2FC|, -log10(p)) cutoffs that
#     approximate the rectangular Up / Down selection, then fan out diagonally so the
#     "significance region" looks like a V -- the hallmark of the diagonal style.
#   - Up / Down DEGs highlighted, top genes labeled with ggrepel.
p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = log2FoldChange, y = neg_log10_p, colour = status)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.65, size = 1.4) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c("Down" = "#2E86C1", "NS" = "grey70", "Up" = "#E74C3C"),
    labels = c("Down" = "Down-regulated",
               "NS"   = "Not significant",
               "Up"   = "Up-regulated"),
    breaks = c("Down", "NS", "Up")
  ) +
  # Vertical cutoffs (|log2FC| = 1)
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-1, 1), linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey40") +
  # Horizontal cutoff (p = 0.05)
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey40") +
  # Diagonal lines -- the defining feature of the diagonal volcano plot.
  # They connect the four (FC=±1, p=0.05) corners to (FC=±xlim, p=top) so that
  # the "significant" region is bounded by slanted lines rather than only axes.
  geom_segment(
    aes(x = 1,  xend =  xlim_range, y = -log10(0.05), yend = ylim_range),
    colour = "#E74C3C", linetype = "dotdash", linewidth = 0.6, inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_segment(
    aes(x = -1, xend = -xlim_range, y = -log10(0.05), yend = ylim_range),
    colour = "#2E86C1", linetype = "dotdash", linewidth = 0.6, inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_text_repel(
    data = subset(df, label != ""),
    aes(label = label),
    size = 3.2, max.overlaps = 30, box.padding = 0.3, segment.colour = "grey50"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-xlim_range, xlim_range)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, ylim_range), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))) +
  labs(
    title = "Diagonal Volcano Plot — group2 vs group1",
    subtitle = "CohortB / CohortA comparison (n = 6 vs 6)",
    x = expression(log[2] * " fold change (group2 / group1)"),
    y = expression(-log[10] * " (" * italic(p) * "-value)"),
    colour = NULL
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, colour = "grey30"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position  = "top"
  )
# Save as PNG
ggsave("diagonal_volcano.png", plot = p, width = 9, height = 7, dpi = 200)
cat("Saved diagonal_volcano.png\n")
file.info("diagonal_volcano.png")
